text:
carla: Hey team — we received an invoice from NOME SRL (IT) that includes 22% VAT for consulting work billed to ACME EU. Sales says ACME asserted reverse charge. Need confirmation on what to ask vendor and whether finance can clear the hold.

carla: Invoice excerpt:```
Invoice: INV-2026-0421
Vendor: NOME SRL, VAT IT12345678901
Customer: ACME LTD
Amount: €10,000
VAT (22%): €2,200
Total: €12,200
```

mike: Can you get the customer's VAT ID? Reverse charge only applies B2B with a valid VAT number. If ACME is B2B, vendor should zero-rate and reference reverse charge. :thumbsup:

giovanni: Hi all, Giovanni from NOME SRL here. We charged VAT because we didn't receive the buyer VAT ID on purchase. If you provide ACME's VAT number + VIES check, we can reissue without VAT. Invoice attached originally as PDF.

sarah: Tax: We need ACME's VAT ID and evidence of B2B status (VIES validation screenshot is fine). For invoices subject to reverse charge the seller should show the buyer VAT ID and state "inversione contabile / reverse charge" on the invoice and cite the legal basis (e.g., art. 17 D.P.R. 633/72 or equivalent). If vendor reissues we can pay the net amount. If not, we will pay VAT now and recover it via VAT return which delays cash reclaim and complicates bookkeeping.

carla: @mike can you ping Sales for ACME contact and VAT?

mike: On it, pinging @lina-sales now.

invoicebot: Invoice INV-2026-0421 uploaded to NetSuite. Flag: VAT discrepancy (holding payment).

lina-sales: ACME VAT: EU987654321 — attaching VIES validation screenshot now. They confirmed B2B and sent PO referencing Redwood account.

mike: Thanks — VIES shows status: VALID. Giovanni, please reissue with no VAT, include buyer VAT EU987654321 and add text: "reverse charge / inversione contabile — operation subject to reverse charge, buyer liable for VAT" and reference the legal clause. Once we get the corrected invoice, finance will release the hold.

giovanni: Understood. I'll reissue and send corrected invoice by EOD with the buyer VAT and reverse charge note.

sarah: When corrected invoice is received, finance: match to PO, update vendor ledger, clear VAT hold, and save VIES screenshot to the audit folder.

carla: Great — closing once reissue received. :white_check_mark:
